description: This file contains the PHP class Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation.GeoZone, which manages geographic zone data within the OpenCart system, including CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Class for managing geographic zones, including CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Adds a new geographic zone to the database and associates zones if provided.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates an existing geographic zone's data and associated zones.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Deletes a geographic zone and its associations.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific geographic zone by ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geographic zones with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of geographic zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Associates a zone with a geographic zone, specifying country and zone IDs.

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Removes zone associations for a specific geographic zone.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves zone associations for a specific geographic zone.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total number of zone associations for a specific geographic zone.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns total zone associations for a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByZoneId
methods.description: Returns total zone associations for a specific zone.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByZoneId
methods.description: Returns total zone associations for a specific zone.
